events.evidence: The government places the army on standby to help deliver fuel to petrol stations if it becomes necessary after panic buying has depleted their stocks.
Power outages are reported in the Northeast China provinces of Liaoning, Jilin, and Heilongjiang.
ISIL–K leader Mawlawi Ziya ul-Haq is killed and more than 80 fighters are arrested during Taliban raids in the eastern Nangarhar Province.

label.note: UK fuel panic buying and China power outages weigh on sentiment; COVID restrictions continue.
